status: design-only; not implemented, persisted, or a legal-compliance determination
visible_purpose_copy: I'll email you when Ioleia is ready to try. Unsubscribe anytime.
founder_ux_direction: No separate consent checkbox. The affirmative action is entering an email and submitting the clearly labelled Join early access form after the purpose and unsubscribe copy are displayed.

consent.affirmative_action: email entered and Join early access submitted
consent.text: exact server-owned purpose/disclosure copy presented for this version
consent.subscription_status: pending or confirmed according to the separately approved production flow

future_server_record.withdrawal: record unsubscribe status and server timestamp; enforce suppression

constraints: This is a UX/data-contract proposal, not legal advice or a claim of CASL compliance.
Production disclosure/consent handling must receive final legal review before launch.
A signup is separate from selection for product testing and creates no Ioleia account.
Do not collect IP address, user agent, or unrelated metadata by default.
Do not create this record from the preview form.
No production endpoint has been approved or wired in this branch.
